SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND DOC_NAME='PODOWN' ORDER BY KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'PETA' AS BUYER, NVL(LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(REPLACE(ADD_DATE,'-',''),' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(REPLACE(RD_DATE,'-',''),' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, NVL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, NVL(PRE_GR_FLAG,' ') AS DOC_TYPE, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, NVL(REMARK2,' ') AS REMARK2, NVL(REF_IF_NO,' ') AS REF_IF_NO FROM KII_PO_KEP_PODETAIL_V WHERE 1=1 AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE KII_PO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL AND DOC_NAME='PODOWN' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
